paragraphs.chinese:
第一季最后一集围绕着 Claire 最想要的一件东西展开：一张完美的全家福。她要求所有人穿白色，摄影师只订了一个小时，还想让全家整整齐齐站在楼梯上，至少这一次看起来像个正常家庭。

当然，这一天几乎从一开始就在崩。背景里的台阶坏了，Claire 决定自己修，结果越修越糟。Haley 又突然长了颗痘，立刻觉得自己已经完全不能拍照。Claire 则死活不肯因为任何人改变计划。

与此同时，Phil 带 Alex 去看 Lakers 比赛，Gloria 和 Manny 也一起。Claire 打电话时 Phil 正玩得开心，干脆没接。接着球场的 kiss cam 正好拍到 Phil 和 Gloria。两个人一开始都不想亲，可全场开始起哄，Gloria 只好飞快亲了 Phil 一下，让镜头赶紧切走。

Claire 其实根本没看到这个吻，可 Phil 以为她看到了，于是之后整天都一副做贼心虚的样子，不停想解释一个 Claire 根本没问的东西。Claire 真正生气的是，她正在为全家福焦头烂额时，Phil 居然不接电话。

Cameron 接了一个婚礼演唱的工作，也希望 Mitchell 跟自己一起去。Mitchell 因为特别讨厌跟陌生人站着寒暄，干脆留在家里照顾 Lily。结果 Cameron 一走，一只鸽子飞进了屋。Mitchell 为了把它赶出去彻底失控。等 Cameron 回家，家具和装饰已经被折腾得一团糟。Cameron 很火，因为 Mitchell 不但没来参加对自己重要的活动，最后还把家里弄坏了。

Luke 这边还要做一个学校作业，采访 Jay 关于 1960 年代的生活。可 Jay 真正的旧故事太无聊，Luke 听着听着就睡着。Jay 于是开始“加工历史”。没一会儿，他已经说自家理发店服务过 Martin Luther King Jr.、Kennedy 家的人，甚至还有 Elvis。Luke 这下终于精神了。

等所有人真的穿好白衣服站到楼梯前，各条线里的火气其实还一点没消。Phil 主动坦白了和 Gloria 被 kiss cam 逼着亲了一下。Cameron 抱怨 Mitchell 没去婚礼。Claire 则越来越崩溃，只想让所有人闭嘴十秒钟，装成一个幸福正常的家庭把照片拍完。

Jay 最后直接告诉她一个最简单的事实：生活本来就不完美。Claire 反过来说，如果他真有什么能快速治好自己这种性格的办法，那就现在拿出来。Jay 的回答是直接往她身上扔了一把泥。

这一下马上变成全家泥巴大战。Claire 为了那套白衣服折腾了一整天，几秒钟就全部毁掉。她一开始气疯了，后来干脆也放弃挣扎，加入大家。

真正的全家福反而是在这个时候拍下来的：每个人都一身泥，笑得乱七八糟，也终于没人再装。它完全不是 Claire 计划的照片，却比那张“完美照”更像他们真实的家。
paragraphs.english:
This season finale is built around one thing Claire wants more than anything: a perfect family portrait. She has everyone wearing white, she has a photographer booked for one hour, and she wants the whole family standing together on the staircase looking normal for once.

Naturally, the day starts falling apart almost immediately. There’s a broken step in the background, and Claire decides to fix it herself. She only makes it worse. Haley gets a pimple and starts acting like the portrait is now impossible. Claire refuses to change the plan for anybody.

Meanwhile, Phil takes Alex to a Lakers game with Gloria and Manny. Claire calls while Phil is having fun and he ignores the phone. Then the kiss cam lands on Phil and Gloria. They try not to kiss, but the whole arena starts booing, so Gloria gives Phil a quick kiss just to make the camera move on.

Claire never actually sees the kiss. Phil thinks she did, though, so he spends the rest of the day acting guilty and trying to explain something she isn’t even asking about. Claire is mainly angry because he ignored her call when she was trying to deal with the portrait disaster.

Cameron has been hired to sing at a wedding and wants Mitchell to come. Mitchell stays home with Lily because he hates standing around making small talk with strangers. While Cameron is gone, a pigeon flies into the house. Mitchell completely loses his mind trying to get it out. By the time Cameron comes home, furniture and decorations are wrecked, and he’s furious that Mitchell skipped something important to him and then destroyed the house anyway.

Luke also needs to interview Jay about life in the 1960s for a school project. Jay’s real stories are boring Luke to sleep, so Jay starts improving history. Before long, he’s claiming the family barbershop served Martin Luther King Jr., the Kennedys, and Elvis. Luke is suddenly very interested.

By the time everybody is finally dressed in white and standing in place, all the other arguments are still sitting there under the surface. Phil confesses the kiss with Gloria. Cameron complains that Mitchell skipped the wedding. Claire becomes more desperate to make everyone stop talking and just look like a happy family for ten seconds.

Jay finally tells her the obvious: life is not perfect. Claire snaps back that if he has some quick fix for her personality, he should go ahead and give it to her. Jay responds by throwing mud at her.

That starts a full mud fight. Within seconds, the clean white outfits Claire obsessed over are ruined. At first she is horrified. Then she gives up and joins in.

That’s when they finally take the picture—covered in mud, laughing, and not pretending anymore. It’s nothing like the portrait Claire planned, but it ends up looking much more like the family she actually has.
